name: 台北公車動態
subtitle: 公車在哪、多久到，打開就知道
description:
公車到哪了，下一班還要多久？打開地圖就能看。

台北公車動態把公車、捷運、YouBike 與步行接在一起。找附近站牌、看官方到站時間，或輸入目的地比較整趟行程，不必分別切換交通方式。

【在 3D 地圖上，看車往哪裡走】
點選車牌，查看公車位置與行駛方向。拉遠地圖看全城車流，放大後跟著一輛車走。捷運列車依官方進站資料推估位置，高架與地下路段分層呈現。

【先比較，再出發】
一起比較公車、捷運與 YouBike 接駁。總時間納入走路、候車、搭車與借還車，旁邊列出預計抵達時刻；想少走路或少轉乘，也能設定個人偏好。點開步驟先看行程，按下出發才開始導航。

【上車前、上車後，都知道下一步】
在 App 內走到站牌，看看往這一站開來的車。上車後可確認實際車牌，查看沿途站牌、剩餘站數與下車時間預估。定位短暫不穩時保留行程進度，訊號恢復後接續更新；查看後面的路段，也不會改變正在進行的導航。

【YouBike，接上最後一段路】
走到捷運站太遠，或下車後還有一段路？規劃時一併比較適合的 YouBike 接駁。途中可點開借、還車站，查看目前可借車輛、可還空位與更新時間。數量以現場為準，App 不提供車輛或車位預約。

【免費功能】
路線規劃、導航、官方到站資訊、站牌收藏、YouBike 站點資訊與 3D 公車地圖，無需登入即可使用。支援系統深色模式與 English，英文站名同時保留中文。

【台北公車 Pro｜選用訂閱】
• 捷運列車動態與跟隨鏡頭
• 快到站時的下車通知與震動提醒
• 動態島與鎖定畫面的搭車資訊
• 常用行程桌面小工具與捷徑
• 個人路線偏好
免費版每天可試用 3 次列車動態或跟隨鏡頭。

月費 NT$39、年費 NT$390，兩種方案功能相同。符合資格的帳號可免費試用 7 天，之後依所選方案自動續訂。確認購買時由 Apple 帳號付款；除非在本期結束前至少 24 小時關閉自動續訂，否則會於本期結束前 24 小時內收取下一期費用。可在 App Store 帳號設定中管理或取消訂閱。
使用條款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
隱私政策：https://rio10255254.github.io/TaipeiBus/privacy.html

定位權限為選用，也能手動選擇出發地。開啟 Pro 背景搭車資訊或下車提醒時，導航會在背景使用定位；行程結束即停止。提醒方式依 iPhone 的通知與震動設定而定。

公車與 YouBike 資料來自臺北市公開資料服務，公車車程另參考交通部 TDX 站間資料，捷運資料來自臺北捷運公開資料。公車位置依車輛回報更新，捷運位置為推估，皆可能受資料更新頻率影響；到站與抵達時間不保證準點。地圖採用 MapLibre／OpenFreeMap（OpenStreetMap 資料），地點搜尋、步行與自行車路線由 Apple 地圖提供。服務範圍依收錄路線而定，YouBike 目前限臺北市。本 App 為獨立開發，並非政府、公車業者或臺北捷運官方 App。

reviewNotes:
VERSION 1.8.9 (149.1.0). No app account, login or sample files are needed.

BACKGROUND NAVIGATION / GUIDELINE 2.5.4
Background location supports a journey the rider explicitly starts: phone GPS advances trip progress and updates the alighting reminder and Lock Screen Live Activity while the app is backgrounded. These features require Pro; ordinary browsing and route preview do not activate background navigation. A countdown alone is not the reason for background location.

HOW TO REACH THE FEATURES
1. Open 資料來源與地圖設定 (Information and settings) > 台北公車 Pro > 查看 Pro 方案 (View Pro plans). Complete an Apple sandbox subscription purchase, then return to Pro settings. No app login is required.
2. Enable 動態島與鎖定畫面 (Live Activity) and 下車提醒 (alighting reminder). These switches appear after Pro is active. Allow location access. Notification permission is requested when boarding with reminders enabled.
3. During Taipei operating hours, search for a destination and tap 出發 / 開始導航 (Go / Start Navigation). 步驟 (Steps) only previews the route. After actually boarding, tap 已上車 (Boarded).
4. Return to the Home Screen or lock the device. If iOS asks to allow Live Activities, tap Allow on the activity card. GPS updates advance the active trip; remaining progress is used to update trip information and reschedule the local alighting notification. Dynamic Island is optional: on devices without it, inspect the Lock Screen Live Activity and local notification instead.
5. Tap 結束 (End) to end navigation. Background navigation requires an active, unfinished Pro journey and at least one of these two features enabled. It stops after the journey ends or both features are disabled. The system background location indicator is enabled. Passenger position is processed locally, not uploaded to a developer server.

REVIEW OUTSIDE TAIPEI
For route browsing, manually set departure to 捷運市政府站 (Taipei City Hall MRT) and destination to 臺北車站 (Taipei Main Station). Device GPS outside Taipei will not simulate riding that route. Vehicles and arrivals depend on Taipei operating hours.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
TaipeiBus Pro: com.rio10255254.TaipeiBus.pro.monthly (NT$39/month), com.rio10255254.TaipeiBus.pro.yearly (NT$390/year). Identical features; seven-day free trial for eligible accounts. Submit both subscription versions and the group version with this first public Pro release. The paywall includes renewal terms, Restore Purchases, Manage Subscription, Privacy Policy and Apple standard EULA. Access uses verified StoreKit transactions. Pro adds estimated metro train views/follow camera (three daily free uses), alighting reminders, Live Activity, widgets, saved trips and preferences. Planning, navigation, official arrivals, YouBike information and 3D bus views remain free.

PURPOSE / REGIONS / DATA
For Taipei commuters and visitors, comparing bus, metro, walking and YouBike connections. Chinese and English are available. Taiwan download availability; features operate consistently, with Taipei-network coverage and Taipei City YouBike data. Bike rental/payment is separate.

External services: Taipei City bus GPS/arrivals and YouBike open data; cached TDX station travel times; Taipei Metro public platform reports; MapLibre/OpenFreeMap/OpenStreetMap; Apple MapKit search/walking/cycling; StoreKit. Bus positions use provider GPS; train positions are labelled estimates from platform reports/schedules, not train GPS. Apple Maps receives necessary route/search requests. Live Activities update locally without a push server. No account creation, UGC, ads, AI service or tracking. Source notices are in Information and settings. Independent app, not a government agency or transport operator.

This update fixes navigation continuity through short GPS gaps and empty-results guidance. No synthetic vehicle fixtures are enabled in the submitted build. Remote JSON supplies bounded settings/strings, not executable code.
whatsNew:
1.8.9，讓整趟行程接得更順。

• 一起比較公車、捷運與 YouBike 接駁，納入步行、候車和借還車時間。
• YouBike 借還車站可直接點開，查看目前車輛與空位。
• 改善校園等地點的步行接駁，減少搜尋後無法計算路線的情況。
• 定位短暫變弱時保留行程進度，上車後可用手機定位接續追蹤。
• 查看後續路段時，當前導航繼續進行；剩餘時間與抵達估計的顯示更一致。
• 改善路線比較、地圖呈現與中英文資訊的閱讀；沒有可用方案時提供清楚的下一步。

也帶來捷運列車動態與選用 Pro：動態島、鎖定畫面搭車資訊、下車提醒、小工具、跟隨鏡頭與常用行程。月費 NT$39、年費 NT$390，符合資格者可免費試用 7 天。
